response.rationale: R3 precisely matches the histologic and IHC profile of anaplastic large cell lymphoma (CD30+, CD15-, ALK-), while R1 is a non-specific broad category and C1 redundantly appends CD30 positivity without additional support.

rejected.why: Too broad; does not capture the specific CD30+ large cell morphology.
Redundant completion of R3; lacks histologic support and adds no diagnostic specificity.
